_comment: Each channel is an Internet Archive advanced-search query (mediatype:movies and the safety filter are added automatically). slot = minutes programs are aligned to (0 = back-to-back, gaps get filled with vintage commercials). min/maxMinutes filter program length. sample = how many search hits are turned into the lineup. acceptLanguages: allowed values of the IA 'language' field (items without one are kept). rejectPattern: regex on title/description/file names to drop burned-in foreign subtitles. bumper: transition style between shows (news, leader, terminal, warp, toon, retro, vhs, noir, curtain, neon).
globalExclude: -title:(nsfw OR nude OR nudity OR sex OR sexy OR porn OR erotic OR suicide OR graphic OR xxx OR babes OR striptease OR gore OR karaoke) AND -subject:(nsfw OR porn OR erotic OR adult OR sex OR karaoke) AND -description:(karaoke)

filler.query: collection:classic_tv_commercials OR (subject:(commercials) AND title:(commercials OR adverts OR ads))

channels.name: ANN
channels.title: Archive News Network
channels.query: title:(newscast OR "evening news" OR "news broadcast" OR "nightly news" OR "world news tonight" OR "eyewitness news") AND year:[1970 TO 2000]

channels.name: SPACE
channels.title: Space Age TV
channels.query: (subject:("space opera" OR "outer space" OR "space travel" OR spaceship OR "space exploration" OR astronaut OR "science fiction television") OR title:("space patrol" OR "rocky jones" OR "tom corbett" OR "captain video" OR "flash gordon" OR "buck rogers" OR "space 1999" OR "lost in space" OR "men into space" OR "commando cody")) AND -title:(speedrun OR trailer OR review OR podcast OR reaction OR gameplay OR walkthrough OR "let's play" OR nasa OR launch OR iss OR "office space" OR "classic crap") AND -year:[2001 TO 2100]

channels.name: SCIFI
channels.title: Sci-Fi Theater
channels.query: collection:scifi_movies OR collection:SciFi_Horror OR (collection:classic_tv AND subject:("science fiction" OR "sci-fi" OR scifi))

channels.name: SAT AM
channels.title: Saturday Morning VHS
channels.query: subject:(commercials) AND title:("saturday morning" OR "vhs recording" OR "tv recording" OR cartoons OR "kids wb" OR "fox kids" OR nickelodeon)

channels.name: MTV2K
channels.title: Video Jukebox
channels.query: subject:("music video") AND year:[1978 TO 2000] AND -subject:(ktv OR "cover songs" OR avseq) AND -description:("cover songs")
